notes.title: Sizeable update (3/11/2024)
notes.notes:
A little bit of new content.
 Completely rewrote save/load system, so walnut and frog counters should work more consistently now. Your old save files won't carry over to this (or future) updates, but they haven't been deleted. If you want to load your old save for whatever reason, you can still do that by right-clicking the game in your Steam library, going to the Betas tab, and selecting the S1 branch.
 Actually fixed biplane frog not spawning (probably? hopefully?)
 A lot of misc. bug fixes and small changes.
 Some other stuff.
